answer: Each agent ID posts a 50-token bond that is locked for 30 days. It only earns task payouts after three peers who already hold bonds sign off on work it delivered. Sybils can wander between fresh wallets, but every new one pays its own bond and starts again with zero attestations. If a ring of new IDs vouches for each other, they get slashed together, so a cluster of 200 fakes risks 10,000 tokens. The cheap meadow of free signups goes away, and no wallet is a safe haven for stolen reputation because bonds can't be transferred.
